feature: Pencarian Notice Search berdasarkan Court Trial date range, Warrant No., dan Court Case (endpoint courttrial, warrantofarrest, courtcase) di staff portal
note: UI memanggil endpoint courttrial, warrantofarrest, dan courtcase; ketiganya hanya terdaftar di api-authorization.properties:23 tanpa controller di ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi. Bukan bagian AOS; tidak ada story epic 31 yang menyebutnya.
note_en: The UI calls the courttrial, warrantofarrest and courtcase endpoints; all three are only listed in api-authorization.properties:23 with no controller in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi. Not part of the AOS; no epic 31 story mentions them.
